info.title: Rex CRM Contacts API
info.description: Session-authenticated JSON API for the Contacts module. Every error is an RFC 9457 problem document served as application/problem+json with a stable `code`. State-changing requests (POST, PUT, DELETE) need the XSRF header: read the XSRF-TOKEN cookie set by any earlier web response and echo it in X-XSRF-TOKEN.

post.summary: Log in with email and password
post.description: Starts a session (the session cookie is regenerated). Throttled by the `login` rate limiter.

422.description: Either `validation_failed` (missing or malformed email/password, with `errors`) or `invalid_credentials` (the credentials do not match).

value.title: Invalid credentials
value.detail: These credentials do not match our records.

post.summary: Log out and invalidate the session

get.description: `q` is one box matched against the contact name (substring), phone digits (when `q` looks like a phone number) and email domain prefix; a contact matches if any of these match. The explicit filters combine with AND, and with `q`. Results are ordered by name, then id, and paged by cursor: pass `meta.next_cursor` back as `cursor`. Changing the filters and reusing an old cursor is harmless: the cursor only marks a position in the name order. A search is stopped after a server-configured time (2 seconds by default) and returns 422 `search_too_broad`; add characters or another filter.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search. A contact matches when its name contains the text, when one of its email domains starts with it, or, only when the text looks like a phone number (an optional `+`, then digits, spaces, dashes and brackets, with at least two digits), when one of its phone numbers contains those digits. A one-character `q` is a prefix match on the name and the email domain. Operator characters are treated as text. Ignored when nothing in it is searchable.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the contact name, so `chloe s` finds `Chloe Smith` and `o'reilly` finds `O'Reilly`. A separator typed as a space or a hyphen matches either. When no word in the text has two or more characters (for example `a b`), it matches a name prefix instead.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: A full or partial phone number. Formatting (spaces, dashes, parentheses, leading +) is allowed and ignored: the value is reduced to digits, one leading trunk 0 is dropped (so the local `0412 345 678` finds `+61412345678`), and the result is matched as a substring of stored phone numbers. A value with fewer than two digits left is ignored, as if the filter were absent.

parameters.name: email_domain
parameters.description: Exact, case-insensitive match on the part of an email after the last `@`. A leading `@` is ignored, so `@example.com` equals `example.com`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from `meta.next_cursor` or `meta.prev_cursor` (or the `cursor` in `links.next` or `links.prev`) of an earlier response. A malformed cursor is a 422 `validation_failed` on `cursor`. There is no first or last page link: `links.first` and `links.last` are always null.

422.description: `validation_failed`, for example a malformed `cursor`, or `search_too_broad`: the search matched too many contacts to sort in time.

cursor: The cursor is not a valid page cursor.

post.description: Requires an `Idempotency-Key` header. The server generates the contact id (a lowercase UUID) and returns it in the body and in the `Location` header. A retry with the same key and an identical request replays the stored 201 (marked with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`) with the same id for 24 hours, so exactly one contact is created; the same key with a different request is rejected. Validation errors are not stored.

Location.description: Absolute URL of the created contact

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present and `true` when this response was replayed from a previous request with the same Idempotency-Key.

400.description: `idempotency_key_missing` (the Idempotency-Key header is absent or empty) or `idempotency_key_invalid` (it is longer than 255 characters).

409.description: `idempotency_request_in_progress`: a request with the same Idempotency-Key is still being processed. Retry after the `Retry-After` delay.

422.description: Either `validation_failed` (with `errors`) or `idempotency_key_reused` (the key was already used with a different request).

put.summary: Create or replace a contact at a client-supplied id
put.description: Creates the contact when none exists with this id (201) or replaces it (200). Idempotent: repeating the same request leaves the same state. Keyed by the UUID in the path. Emails are trimmed and lowercased; phones are trimmed and never reformatted. Duplicates are collapsed (the 10-item limits count entries before de-duplication). A non-UUID `contact` yields 422 `validation_failed` with an error on `id`.

post.summary: Place a call to a contact
post.description: Requires an `Idempotency-Key` header. A retry with the same key and an identical request replays the stored 2xx response (marked with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`) for 24 hours; the same key with a different request is rejected. Only 2xx responses are stored. If `phone` is omitted the contact's first phone is dialled. A telephony `failed` outcome is returned as 502 `telephony_failed`, never as a 2xx.

200.description: The call was placed. Outcome is never `failed` here.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present and `true` when this response was replayed from a previous request with the same Idempotency-Key.

400.description: `idempotency_key_missing` (the Idempotency-Key header is absent or empty) or `idempotency_key_invalid` (it is longer than 255 characters).

409.description: `idempotency_request_in_progress`: a request with the same Idempotency-Key is still being processed. Retry after the `Retry-After` delay.

422.description: Either `validation_failed` (bad phone, a phone that is not one of the contact's numbers, or a contact with no phones; with `errors`) or `idempotency_key_reused` (the key was already used with a different request).

502.description: `telephony_failed`: the telephony provider failed to place the call.

sessionCookie.name: laravel-session
sessionCookie.description: Session cookie issued by POST /login. The cookie name comes from config('session.cookie'), so it depends on the deployment; `laravel-session` is the default here.

xsrfHeader.name: X-XSRF-TOKEN
xsrfHeader.description: Value of the XSRF-TOKEN cookie. Required on POST, PUT and DELETE; a mismatch returns 419 `csrf_token_mismatch`.

ContactId.name: contact
ContactId.description: Contact UUID. On GET, DELETE and POST calls a malformed id returns 404 `contact_not_found`; on PUT it returns 422 `validation_failed` with an error on `id`.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated unique key (1 to 255 characters), scoped to the user and operation.

CsrfTokenMismatch.description: `csrf_token_mismatch`: the XSRF token is missing or expired.

phones.0: The phones.0 must be an E.164 Australian (+61) or New Zealand (+64) number, for example +61412345678.

ContactNotFound.description: `contact_not_found`: no contact with that id (including malformed ids).

TooManyRequests.description: `too_many_requests`: rate limit exceeded (60 per minute per user on /api/v1; the login limiter on /login).

ServerError.description: `server_error`: an unexpected error. The body never contains a message, class or trace.

PhoneNumber.description: E.164 Australian (+61) or New Zealand (+64) number. Input is trimmed, never reformatted.

CallOutcome.description: `failed` is surfaced as 502 `telephony_failed` and never appears in a successful CallResult.

ContactInput.description: Request body for PUT. The id comes from the path.

first.description: Always null: cursor paging has no first-page link.

last.description: Always null: cursor paging has no last-page link.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

prev_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the previous page; null on the first page.

phone.description: Must be one of the contact's phones. Defaults to the contact's first phone.

errors.description: Present on `validation_failed`: field name to list of messages.
